semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Submission of Articles of Incorporation or equivalent constitutional/registration documents for the legal entity.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Primary requirement for general corporate documentation under ITP 4.4.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Establishes the baseline legal existence and registration status of the proposing entity.

semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Submission of specific autonomy and commercial law compliance documents for state-owned enterprises.
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: Conditional continuation of documentation requirements under ITP 4.6, triggered by entity type (state-owned).
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: Refines the legal entity verification process to address public sector specificities, ensuring financial and operational independence from the Employer.
